title: Main Bewaye Muslim Hon Mera Naam
body:
MEIN BEWAYE MUSLIM HOON MERA NAAM RUQAYYA HAI
ghazi ki behan hu mai haider as mera baba hai
1.  HOKE BERBAAD MEIN KIS TERHA SE WATAN JAWOUNGI
DAAGH MUSLIM KA MEIN IS DIL PE NA SEH PAWOUNGI
HUM PE DHAYE HAI MAZALIM JO MUSALMANO NE
JAKE NANA KI LEHAD PER MEIN WO BATLAWOUNGI
MEIN BEWAYE MUSLIM HOON MERA NAME RUQAYYA HAI,
GHAZI KI BEHAN HOON MEIN HYDER MERA BABA HAI
MEIN BEWAYE MUSLIM HOON MERA NAAM RUQAYYA HAI
2.  MARA GAYA HAI LOGO GHURBAT MERA WAALI
MERI MANG BHI HAI UJDI AGHOSH BHI HAI KHAALI
KARBOBALA SE PEHLE GHER MERA LUT GAYA HAI
3. MAA NE HAI BACHPANE SE HUMKO WAFA SIKHAYI
GHAZI KI ZINDAGI MEIN SHEHH PE NA ANCH AAYI
ZAINAB KA SATH MENE HER GAAM NIBHAYA HAI
4. DO PHOOL JAISE BACCHE ANKHO KE MERI TAARE
BABA KE SATH DONO GHURBAT MEIN GAYE MAARE
AUN AUR MOHAMMED PE UNKO KIYA SADQA HAI
5. MUSLIM PE KUFIYO NE KYA KYA SITAM NA DHAYE
DHOKE SE KIYA HUMLA SHOLEY BHI HAI BERSAYE
GARDAN MEIN RASAN BANDHI GALIYO MEIN PHIRAYA HAI
6. MARO NA TAZIYANE ZAINAB KO AYE LAYEENO
LILLAH HA NA SATAWO AHMED KI NAWASI KO
PEHCHANO MUSALMANO YE SANIYE ZEHRA HAI
7. MEIN KAISE BHOOL JAWO WO DARDNAAK MANZAR
KUFE KE DAR PE DEKHI MUSLIM KI LASH BE SAR
MAZLOOM KI GHURBAT PE DIL MERA PHAT GAYA HAI
8. ISLAAM PE RAHEGA AHSAAN GHUMZADA KA
QURBANIYA HAI JISKI AGHAAZ KARBALA KA
ANKHO MEIN JISKA AANSO AWAAZ DERAHA HAI
9. KYO KER RAQAM HO MANZAR KAISE PADHE SHUJAYAT
BIBI KE DIL PE GUZRI KUFE MEIN JO QAYAMAT
TADPI HAI LAASHE MUSLIM BIBI NE JAB KAHA HAI
MEIN BEWAYE MUSLIM HOON MERA NAME RUQAYYA HAI
GHAZI KI BEHAN HOO MEIN HYDER MERA BABA HAI
